tools.name: bash
tools.args:

function Sql($q){

$frames = Sql "SELECT timestamp, app_name, window_name, browser_url, focused FROM frames WHERE datetime(timestamp) > datetime('now','-1 hour') ORDER BY timestamp ASC LIMIT 1000"
$apps   = Sql "SELECT app_name, COUNT(*) AS frames, MIN(timestamp) AS first_seen, MAX(timestamp) AS last_seen FROM frames WHERE datetime(timestamp) > datetime('now','-1 hour') GROUP BY app_name ORDER BY frames DESC LIMIT 50"
$urls   = Sql "SELECT browser_url, COUNT(*) AS frames, MIN(timestamp) AS first_seen, MAX(timestamp) AS last_seen FROM frames WHERE datetime(timestamp) > datetime('now','-1 hour') AND browser_url IS NOT NULL AND browser_url <> '' GROUP BY browser_url ORDER BY frames DESC LIMIT 100"
$sw     = Sql "SELECT event_type, COUNT(*) AS n FROM ui_events WHERE datetime(timestamp) > datetime('now','-1 hour') GROUP BY event_type ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 20"
$out = @{ frames=$frames; apps=$apps; urls=$urls; ui_events=$sw }
$out | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8 | Set-Content "$tmp\raw.json" -Encoding utf8
Write-Output "frames rows: $($frames.data.Count) | apps: $($apps.data.Count) | urls: $($urls.data.Count)"
Write-Output "bytes: $((Get-Item "$tmp\raw.json").Length)"","description":"Query frames, apps, URLs, ui events","timeout":180}
